event_semantics.panel_animation: open() defaults to animated panel; open({animate:false}) and open(false) disable the panel transition for that accepted opening and replace the previous choice; default template consumes context.animate; inline has no panel animation; overlay remains independently styled; reduced-motion CSS wins
event_semantics.interrupted_close: open during closing cancels the pending close; no modal:after-close for the interrupted transition; original focus-return target is preserved until completed close
event_semantics.content_completion: modal:after-content-upload fires for success and error after remote state leaves loading; aborted requests do not emit completion
event_semantics.bubbling: modal:* events bubble and are composed like the base modal component and sf-drawer; detail.modal names the emitting modal; on* helpers and SF.create handlers receive only their own modal's events; ancestor addEventListener listeners also hear nested modals and must check detail.modal (migration smart.modal 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0)

scroll_lock.ownership: first visible ordinary or Smart Modal holds the shared lease until the last visible layer leaves; existing html/body overflow-hidden classes are preserved
scroll_lock.compensation: add measured scrollbar width to computed padding-inline-end; preserve original inline declaration and priority; skip padding writes when preserve-scroll-gap is false or scrollbar gap is zero
scroll_lock.restoration: restore only an unchanged declaration written by the lease; preserve author padding changes; use the original document nodes

accessibility.accessible_name: aria-label wins; otherwise the title is linked through aria-labelledby
keyboard: Escape closes the top dismissible modal
Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the top modal
focus: focus moves to the panel on open
Tab from the panel enters the first available control; Shift+Tab enters the last
hidden, disabled, inert and negative-tabindex controls are not tab boundaries
a panel without available controls retains focus on itself
focus returns to the previously active element after close
accessibility.stack: ordinary and Smart Modal share document ordering and scroll-lock lifetime; only the top modal handles keyboard dismissal and focus trapping; removing a background modal does not steal focus
accessibility.inline_focus: display=inline does not capture focus on open or restore a previous focus on close; Escape does not dismiss the inline region
accessibility.native_radio: group by nonempty name, form owner and tree; use checked eligible input as Tab boundary; otherwise first for forward panel entry and last for reverse; preserve native arrow keys and checked/tabindex; read selection live
accessibility.closing_content: accepted close immediately freezes panel descendants while named visible panel holds focus and Tab; background close does not steal focus; cancelled close unchanged; reopen/final close/teardown release only owned temporary inert attributes and observer; author inert regions preserved
accessibility.embedded_document: top visible layer owns zero-size guards outside panel; relay trusted native Tab into either iframe end without reading child DOM; frame exit wraps to parent control or semantic dialog panel before next native entry; guards follow stack/projection and are removed on final close; child key events remain child-owned
accessibility.unavailable_opener: verify actual focus return; otherwise focus remaining visible modal, remembered available semantic ancestor, page main or body; temporary fallback tabindex is cleaned up without overwriting author changes
accessibility.minimized: open instance remains registered but has no active document layer; content is inert and aria-hidden; minimizing top restores remaining dialog or opener, background minimization keeps focus; restoring raises and focuses the dialog; inline ignores minimization

theme.motion: overlay and animated panels use --sf-duration-normal and --sf-animation; center offset uses --sf-space-1/2; prefers-reduced-motion disables transitions; close completion waits for the longest computed opacity/transform duration plus delay across panel and overlay after projection; reopen cancels pending completion
theme.header_layout: default title or header slot wraps in normal flow alongside non-shrinking close/minimize actions; targets use compact UI height and inherited UI radius; ordering follows document direction
theme.minimize_glyph: decorative currentColor line inherits base IconButton icon-variant semantic foreground; no font dependency
invariants: large surfaces use --sf-radius--surface while compact actions retain --sf-radius--ui
light and dark theme preserve readable content and visible focus

backend_call.boundary: the backend emits the custom-element artifact and asset activation; browser lifecycle and side effects remain frontend-owned

compatibility.breaking_change_policy: additive parameters and events only unless a separately accepted migration contract exists
